comment: Coverage floors for the CI coverage job (regression floors no more than 1.5 points below measured, not tier targets; raise as coverage climbs). Mirrored into the coverage:check npm script in package.json and guarded by test/unit/coverage_thresholds_sync.test.js. Re-measured 2026-09-23 with the declared siblings checked out: 92.83 lines/statements, 86.81 branches, and 86.73 functions over 1656 passing unit tests. Both coverage scripts use --all. The sole exclusion is documented below.

exclusions.src/chain/bufferutils.js: Non-owned bitcoinjs-lib replacement copied over node_modules/bitcoinjs-lib/src/bufferutils.js by the Dockerfile; runtime behavior is covered through src/chain/apply_bufferutils_patch.js.
